sources.title: Flightradar24 historical website playback
sources.creator: Flightradar24
sources.role: Sparse public historical map observations: timestamps, flight IDs, callsigns and horizontal positions, cross-checked against separately sourced ADSB.lol geometric tracks
sources.acquisition: Anonymous Firefox/Selenium; 261 snapshots at two-minute intervals for six stationary November 4–6 desk recordings, plus 32 snapshots for the moving November 3 recording as a flight inventory only. No credentials or subscription settings altered.
sources.altitude_policy: FR24 displayed altitude has no verified ellipsoidal basis; it is not used for acoustic geometry.
sources.validation_scope: Known-position recognition review and explicitly flight-conditioned, geographically ambiguous single-curve Texas experiment; not blind localization or independent acoustic identity truth.
sources.license: Redistribution permission not verified; raw observations retained locally for research review.
sources.additional_capture_2026_11_07: 38 two-minute snapshots for 2026_11_07_15_01_53_1.mp3. Receiver context is an explicit working assumption pending confirmation.

sources.title: readsb JSON trace fields: ground speed, true track and geometric climb rate
sources.role: Primary schema for optional ground-motion preservation; existing private ADSB.lol caches supply measurements. Branch snapshot retained for reproducibility.
sources.transforms: Unit conversion to m/s and geometric-only vertical rates; optional Hermite interpolation does not fit audio or receiver position.

sources.title: Texas phone corpus statewide development evaluation
sources.acquisition: Previously cached state-wide desk flights; new whole-state replay discovery and geometric full traces for four November 7 recordings. No new FR24 acquisition.
sources.transforms: WGS84 trajectory/retarded-time fits; optional reported-motion interpolation; complete-state corridor grids; post-search user-site evaluation. SRTM plus EGM96 for observer height. Both six-second and exact-start protocols retained.
sources.redistribution: Original phone media remain private and are excluded from public CI/media bundles. Metadata and reproducibility output are local research artifacts.
sources.result: Automatic primary attempts fail the two-mile target. The reviewed turboprop interval reaches 320.5 m only with the exact filename-start assumption.

sources.title: Bayesian Filtering and Smoothing, Second Edition
sources.creator: Simo Särkkä and Lennart Svensson
sources.role: Primary reference for linear Kalman filtering and Rauch–Tung–Striebel smoothing; independent analytic tests validate the implemented Doppler behavior.
sources.transforms: Author-hosted PDF retained unchanged locally and parsed with pdfinfo; no redistribution license asserted.

sources.title: Fixed-uncertainty trajectory reconstruction after statewide localization failures
sources.acquisition: Reuses original private phone recordings and the previously archived Texas-wide ADSB.lol geometric traces, reported speed/true track/geometric rate, SRTM and EGM96. No new flight or audio acquisition.
sources.transforms: Fixed position/velocity Kalman + RTS estimate, Hermite densification and complete retarded-time curve fits. Six-second clock allowance and all aircraft types retained.
sources.receiver_truth: Post-search evaluation only; no receiver/audio/aircraft ID supplied to telemetry reconstruction. The turboprop interval was previously reviewed, so this is assisted development evidence.
sources.result: Reviewed turboprop statewide winner is 426.5 m from desk; two walking case winners remain distant. Exact geometry optimizations preserve the winner and leading groups in a paired statewide replay.
sources.redistribution: Private original phone audio is unchanged and remains excluded from public bundles.
